verdict: Yes, with a strong community. Bonkerscorner from Ulhasnagar pitched unisex streetwear on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal, with one of the larger revenue figures in the dataset. It showed streetwear can scale from a small town if the brand connects with young buyers.
angle: Oversized tees, hoodies and cargos sell to young buyers of any gender, which simplifies sizing and design. Streetwear lives on Instagram and YouTube culture, drops and collaborations. Fast design cycles and low prices are essential.
